name: Product Hunt
notes: Big launch platform. Launch timing matters (00:01 PT). Supports scheduling a launch date.

name: BetaList
notes: Pre-launch/beta startups. Free tier has a review queue; paid skip-the-line option.

name: AlternativeTo
notes: Positioned as alternatives to existing tools - pick the competitors to list against.

name: SaaSHub
notes: SaaS catalog with alternatives pages.

name: Uneed
notes: Product Hunt-style launch calendar; free launches queue days/weeks out.

name: Peerlist Launchpad
notes: Weekly launch cycle tied to a personal Peerlist profile.

name: MicroLaunch
notes: Monthly leaderboard for indie products.

name: Launching Next
notes: Simple startup listing; form submission.

name: Startup Stash
notes: Resource directory organized by category; paid listing options exist.

name: DevHunt
notes: Dev-tool launches; sign-in is GitHub OAuth only.

name: OpenAlternative
notes: Open-source alternatives only - skip for closed-source brands.

name: Indie Hackers Products
notes: Product profile tied to a community account; the community side is covered by discovery.

name: There's An AI For That
notes: AI tools only. Large traffic; paid review queue options.

name: Toolify
notes: AI tools directory.

name: Futurepedia
notes: AI tools directory; submission via form.

name: Fazier
notes: Launch platform with daily/weekly badges.

name: TinyLaunch
notes: Lightweight launch listing for indie projects.

name: StartupBase
notes: Community launch feed.

name: 10words
notes: Describe the product in ten words; newsletter-driven.

name: Startups.fyi
notes: Curated newsletter + directory; submission via external form.

name: Crunchbase
notes: Company profile - valuable for SEO/credibility rather than launch traffic.

name: G2
notes: Review platform; vendor listing needs a work email and manual vendor verification - expect a human step.

name: Capterra
notes: Gartner-owned software directory; vendor signup with manual review.

name: PitchWall
notes: Startup community feed. Login is Google/Microsoft/Discord only (no email signup). Formerly betapage.co (now redirects here).

name: Directory Launch Hub
notes: Simple submit form; the original form-filling test target.

name: Tiny Startups
notes: Google login opens a popup (it shows up in list_tabs - switch to it); email/password signup has hCaptcha (the user solves it). The old actor never completed a submission here.

name: tools.so
notes: Submission is a Tally form, no account. Success = the page says 'recorded' - don't misread that as a failure.

name: SideProjectors
notes: Email/password signup with a verification link. Long form; the 'market' tag picker can trap you in a loop - pick 1-2 tags and move on; skip the optional analytics/selling sections.

name: Indie Products
notes: Google sign-in only. One short modal form; the product-type dropdown is a custom widget - click to open, read_page, click the option.

name: Startup Buffer
notes: No account; asks for a contact email + one screenshot + text fields. May show a Cloudflare challenge - the user solves it.

name: StartupRanking
notes: Startup ranking directory.

name: StartupInspire
notes: Startup showcase directory.
